name: stagger-cascade
title: Stagger Cascade
description: Child elements enter in sequence where each successive delay is computed from the previous child's actual animation end (not a fixed step) — cascades that stay correct even when children have different durations.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- In View Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
